q: how many times did the cutover date move? list them.
reply:
ok, here's all the cutover date shifts i've seen:

1. originally oct 12 (early aug timeline)
2. priya pushed to sep 28 (tue 11 aug — she thought oct 12 was too tight)
3. then nov 5 (wed 19 aug, more breathing room)
4. then nov 15 (sat 5 sep, dep updates broke things)
5. then back to oct 12 (fri 18 sep, legal signed off)
6. then priya wanted oct 26 (wed 30 sep, said nov 15 was too far)
7. finally locked at oct 12 again (mon 19 oct, no more changes)

so 6 moves before it stuck. that timeline has been through more iterations than the billing schema.
